greeting: Remnant Keeper Echoes on comms. Stage 1: The Edge of Memory. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running What Remains. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I put fear on a schedule. It keeps missing meetings.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Enter the Remnant zone.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Enter the Remnant zone; Meet the Keepers of Echoes; Learn what persists after transcendence. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Journey to Remnant, where echoes of the old world linger. Immediate move: Enter the Remnant zone.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: The Edge of Memory. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Ghosts of Paths Not Taken.
rumor: A sealed wing now contains footprints from boots not yet manufactured.
People keep repeating one clue from The Edge of Memory: 'Learn what persists after transcendence'.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn barely exists in Remnant space. Treat every glow as suspect.
dialog.time_noon: Noon glitch surges can rewrite exits. Keep fallback routes memorized.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk brings memory bleed. If you hear old voices, log and move.
dialog.time_night: Night in Remnant is archive static and teeth. Stay together.

party_reactions.kade: Remnant Keeper Echoes sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Remnant Keeper Echoes accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Remnant Keeper Echoes talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
